title.zh-CN: 更清晰的 AI 回复与更可靠的本地操作
title.en: Clearer AI replies and more reliable local actions

items.zh-CN: AI 回复现在会正确显示标题、粗体、列表、表格和代码块，长内容也更容易阅读。
items.en: AI replies now render headings, emphasis, lists, tables, and code blocks correctly, making long answers easier to read.

items.zh-CN: 磁盘分析结果新增目录占用分布图，可以直接点击扇区或勾选目录来选择要清理的项目。
items.en: Disk analysis results now include a directory usage chart, so you can select cleanup items by clicking a slice or checking a directory.

items.zh-CN: 清理确认会重新核对当前选中的路径；某个项目被替换、删除或变成不安全链接时会单独跳过，其他项目仍可继续处理。
items.en: Cleanup confirmation rechecks the selected paths. If one item was replaced, removed, or became an unsafe link, it is skipped individually while other selected items can still proceed.

items.zh-CN: 设置、进程、能力和工具页面的控件样式更加统一，在较窄窗口和嵌入式操作表单中也能保持清晰布局。
items.en: Controls are now more consistent across settings, processes, capabilities, and tools, with clearer layouts in narrow windows and embedded operation forms.
